title: Logotype / Clear space
slide_intent: Protect the space around a signature because competing objects can weaken recognition.
strategic_value: An uncluttered boundary can help Duolingo’s wordmark stand out in busy compositions.
demonstration: A clearance diagram accompanies an instruction to keep graphics and text outside the marked area.
practical_value: Use the illustrated boundary when placing nearby content.

content_islands.name: Clearance diagram
content_islands.spec: Place the logotype and its marked exclusion area in the large left panel.

content_islands.name: Exclusion instruction
content_islands.spec: Place the heading and prohibition on graphics and text in the right column.

reference_purposes.Intent: The copy explains that clear space lets the logotype stand out.
reference_purposes.Application: The diagram provides a boundary for placing nearby material.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Objects, graphics and text are prohibited within the shown clear space.

ingredient.name: Logotype clear space
ingredient.application: Keep graphics and text outside the illustrated boundary.
ingredient.scope: Historical archived guidelines. Applies to the logotype diagram; do not invent a numerical clearance beyond what it shows.
